_comment: Copy to config.json and edit, OR set the same values as env vars. Env vars win over this file.
_rpcPort_note: Leave rpcPort out to auto-detect the chain (probes mainnet 58812, then testnet 58813). Add "rpcPort": 58812 or 58813 to pin one.
_or_use_a_cookie_instead_of_user_pass: point rpcCookie at your datadir/.cookie and remove rpcUser/rpcPass
_usd_note: USD figures use a live NonKYC price. Pin "veilUsd": 0.0012 to fix it, or set "noUsd": true (env VEIL_NO_USD=1) to drop all dollar figures. Use this on testnet, where coins have no market value.
_snitchLabels_note: Optional: name known transparent addresses in the Snitch List (also see snitch-labels.json)
